subject: Request: Headcount reallocation & backfill approval for Platform PM
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, people-ops@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Headcount reallocation & backfill approval for Platform PM

Team —

Quick context: Priya (Platform PM, IC-3) submitted resignation effective 2026-04-09. She’s been the lead on the performance and KV-cache rollout work that unlocks significant cost savings and is on the critical path to the Dedicated capacity optimizations we promised to a few customers.

Immediate ask: I’m requesting a headcount backfill approval (freeze exception) for 1x Platform PM (IC-3) and permission to convert one open SWE trainee req (SWE-III req #1457) to a short-term contractor if we can’t onboard a permanent hire within 6 weeks.

Why this is urgent:
- Roadmap impact: Without a direct PM owner we risk slipping KV-cache delivery by 4–6 weeks; that delays cost-optimizations tied to Q2 commitments to two enterprise customers.
- Revenue exposure: Delays could reduce committed Dedicated capacity ramp by ~10% in Q3 for one mid-market account (see sheet).
- Team bandwidth: Engs are already split across outages and the infra refactor; shifting PM responsibilities to eng leads will lower throughput on infra infra projects.

Options I’m proposing (ranked):
1) Approve immediate backfill hire (preferred) — open req, expedite interviews.
2) Approve freeze exception + contractor (3 months) while we run hiring pipeline.
3) Defer and re-prioritize roadmap (delay non-customer-facing infra items).

I attached a short HC impact spreadsheet and a revised platform roadmap with outcomes removed/shifted per option. Please let me know decision or what additional data you need — would like a thumbs by EOD Friday so we can start recruiter outreach.

Attachments: hc_impact_2026Q2.xlsx, revised_platform_roadmap_Q2-Q3.pdf

Thanks,
Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Director, Platform Product
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, people-ops@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Headcount reallocation & backfill approval for Platform PM

Olga —

Thanks for the context and the attachments. A few quick clarifying questions before I sign off:

1) Cost delta: What is the expected FY impact of hiring vs contractor for the 3-month window (fully loaded)? Put numbers in the HC sheet if you can.
2) Tradeoffs: If we convert the open SWE-III req to a contractor, what’s the specific delay to the infra refactor you mentioned? We need an estimate in sprint weeks.
3) Alternatives: Any internal candidate for interim PM coverage? If so, what’s the ramp risk?

If the revenue exposure is as you suggest we should prioritize low friction options (contractor + expedite hiring). Looping Vivek for budget trade-offs. I can greenlight a freeze exception for a contractor up to $X (need actual number), but if this converts to permanent headcount we have to route through FP&A and agree on ongoing funding.

-Markus
VP, Engineering

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, people-ops@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 12:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Headcount reallocation & backfill approval for Platform PM

Markus —

Answers inline and updated sheet attached.

> 1) Cost delta: What is the expected FY impact of hiring vs contractor for the 3-month window (fully loaded)?
- Hiring (full-time IC-3): ~$180k annual loaded cost => 3 months incremental = ~$45k (pro-rated) but with hiring overhead + ramp we should model ~60k near-term.
- Contractor (3 months): estimated $40k–$55k depending on seniority; we’ve budgeted ~50k for a three-month contractor in HCREQ-4821.

> 2) Tradeoffs: If we convert the open SWE-III req to a contractor, what’s the specific delay to the infra refactor you mentioned?
- Converting SWE-III will push the infra refactor (non-customer-facing) by ~2 sprints (4 weeks). The KV-cache and customer rollout remain highest priority and keep an ENGINEER core on that work.

> 3) Alternatives: Any internal candidate for interim PM coverage?
- Two options: (a) Senior IC-2 (Jane W.) can cover as interim product lead for 4–6 weeks with 25% time taken from current projects (ramp risk medium). (b) Move one of our Staff Eng leads into a short-term PM role — much higher risk and would divert technical execution.

Recommendation: Approve contractor + start permanent hire pipeline in parallel. Contractor to start by 04/01 to shadow Priya for two weeks and take over day-to-day tasks. If we can’t move fast on hiring, convert contractor to perm subject to FP&A approval.

I’ve added the quick cost table in HC sheet and flagged recommended option.

Thanks — Olga

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, people-ops@redwood.com, Jenna Park <jenna@talentworks.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Headcount reallocation & backfill approval for Platform PM

Thanks for the detail, Olga. I reviewed HCREQ-4821 and the attached spreadsheets. Finance position and decision:

- Approve a one-time contractor engagement up to $55,000 (3 months) to cover immediate needs. This is a freeze-exception we will treat as a temporary headcount charge to Q2 operating budget; please code to GL 5203 and tag with HRREQ-4821.
- Approve parallel permanent hire search — if the contractor converts to perm, FP&A will review for OPEX-to-FTE conversion; baseline expectation is that we absorb ongoing cost if this converts and there is headcount capacity in the Q3 planning refresh.
- Condition: Defer conversion of SWE-III req #1457 to permanent until Q3 review; we will not backfill that SWE req in Q2. That tradeoff is acceptable given revenue exposure.

Action items:
1) People Ops (cc’d) — start contractor paperwork and SOW template with Jenna. Target start date 2026-04-01.
2) Olga — post perm job and prioritize candidate pipeline; coordinate interviews with Markus.
3) Markus — confirm runway for infra refactor with SRE leads and confirm the 2-sprint delay estimate.

I’ll mark this as approved for the contractor engagement. Laura, loop me in if you want to amend the condition on SWE req conversion.

-Vivek
Head of Finance (Interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>

Perfect — thanks everyone. We’ll proceed with contractor SOW and target 04/01 start. I’ll begin scheduling interviews this week and keep the hiring pipeline live per Vivek’s note.

Next steps:
- Olga to send draft SOW to Jenna by EOD tomorrow.
- People Ops to create the contractor req and confirm GL code.
- Markus & Olga to review candidate shortlist next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Olga
